text:
rachel_sales: Opening thread for NovaBank POC follow-up. Sales asked for final answers on SAML flow, SCIM auth, RBAC model, domain verification, and a committed Dedicated price. Need SOW language for SSO/SCIM.

diego_se: Quick items we need from client: IdP metadata (XML or URL), preferred NameID format, SCIM token or mTLS cert, group names -> intended roles. Also confirm which domains to verify (org has 2 primary domains).

nova_contact: We'll send IdP metadata and a sample SCIM payload today. SP-initiated preferred, NameID=email. SCIM via bearer token is fine for POC; we'll rotate every 90 days. Domains: novabank.com and novabank-eu.com.

maria_ts: For POC RBAC, we'll map groups to routes using a simple mapping table. Example mapping snippet we plan to use: 
```json
{"groups_to_roles": {"infra":"infra-admin","trade_ops":"trade-analyst"}}
```
We'll run provisioning tests with SCIM rate-limit set to 50 req/min.

vijay_security: Security notes: 1) Recommend mTLS for production SCIM. 2) Audit logs default 90d; enterprise upgrade to 365d affects pricing. 3) SAML cert rotation process: we support metadata re-upload or automatic metadata refresh (if IdP exposes). 4) Domain verification: DNS TXT per domain; expect 1-3 business days per domain. Also need completed security questionnaire before Dedicated commits.

rachel_sales: Pricing ask from NovaBank: committed Dedicated for ~110 req/s sustained, ~1.1M tokens/day. Need monthly reserved + overage, 24/7 support add-on, and EU data residency for prod. Diego, can you prepare a customer-facing estimate calling out caveats (quantization, throughput tuning, per-route RBAC cost)?

diego_se: Will produce estimate. Also note: if they want per-route RBAC with tenant isolation and per-route logging, that will add implementation time and a modest premium to the Dedicated price.

nova_contact: Legal needs minimal SOW clause for SSO/SCIM before they can approve the Dedicated budget. Can you share a short template? Also confirm EU region availability.

legal_bot: SOW snippet available at /templates/sow/identity-brief.md. Key clauses: metadata exchange, cert rotation, provisioning termination, data residency (EU region available), and support SLAs.

vijay_security: I'll draft a short SSO/SCIM SOW clause and the security QA responses. Reminder: if NovaBank opts into 365d logs or mTLS, onboarding timeline and cost will change.

maria_ts: Implementation plan for POC: 1) ingest IdP metadata + configure SP-initiated SAML in staging; 2) configure SCIM with group->role mapping and run a smoke sync; 3) validate DNS TXT for both domains; 4) load test with prefix/KV cache on to measure latency; 5) handoff to eng for Dedicated sizing if tests pass.

rachel_sales: Timeline: collect metadata & SCIM creds today, SOW and estimate within 24h, security QA within 24h. Sync tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
